name: HR Steel (IS 800)
blurb: IS 800:2007 hot-rolled steel design agent for India — loads to IS 875 (Parts 1–5), seismic to IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 + Amd 1/2, ductile detailing to IS 800 Section 12 and IS 18168:2023, IS 808 / IS 1161 sections, IS 2062 steel. Brief in, OpenSees model + calc package + report + 3D viewer out.

tabs.title: Design
tabs.blurb: Paste a brief and the agent writes cfg.py (units N, mm, MPa; kN/m² for area loads), retrieves the loads live from IS 875 / IS 1893 into load_plan.json, runs the engine, fills design/calc_package.json (design_status COMPLETE / INCOMPLETE with reasons) and delivers report.html + viewer_3d.html + STATUS.md + EOR_inputs.json. A new run on a project that already holds a design archives the old one beside it (<project>__<timestamp>). Clauses are retrieved from the IS corpus on this PC (the IS corpus module) — without it the agent cites the standards from memory and flags every value to verify. Zone III–V: OMRF and OCBF are refused (IS 1893 Table 9 Note 1).

fields.label: Design brief
fields.placeholder:
4-storey office, 3 bays @ 9.0 m (X) × 4 bays @ 7.5 m (Y), 4.5 m ground / 3.6 m typical.
Perimeter steel SMRF (IS 800 12.11 + IS 18168). Roof dead 2.8 kN/m² / imposed 0.75 kN/m²; floor dead 3.0 / imposed 4.0 kN/m².
Site: Pune — IS 1893 Zone III, soil Type II, office > 2,000 m² (I = 1.2). Wind: IS 875-3 Vb 39 m/s, terrain category 2. Steel IS 2062 E250.
fields.help: Storeys, bays and spacings (m), loads (kN/m²), site (IS 1893 zone / Annex E town, soil type, occupancy for I; IS 875-3 Vb or Annex A town, terrain category, cyclone belt), lateral system and R, steel grade.

fields.label: Upload files
fields.help: Text / Markdown is read into the brief; a text-based PDF has its text extracted into the brief (scanned pages have no text layer); images are attached as references and sent to the model — the design agent uses the first three, and not every LLM can read images.

tabs.title: Continue
tabs.blurb: Resume a paused or stopped design, or iterate on a finished one with new instructions. The agent keeps its full conversation, so a follow-up like “make the perimeter columns WPB 400×400×305 (IS 808) and rerun” continues THIS design.

fields.label: Follow-up instructions (optional)
fields.placeholder:
e.g. the ground-storey columns are over-stressed under the IS 18168 5.5 overstrength combination — re-check and optimise.
Leave empty to simply resume where the run stopped.
